compiled_state.title: Update project docs to reflect stateful re-review with CI/local parity, arbitration, and tier-decoupling
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Description

**What**: Update CLAUDE.md (architecture section: review pipeline; quick reference table) to reflect the new pipeline. Update relevant skill SKILL.md files (review, fix-bug) where they reference review-cycle behavior or REVIEW-DEFENSE inline comments.
**Why**: SC6 closes with documentation accuracy so future agents have correct awareness of the new pipeline.
**Scope**:
  IN:
  - CLAUDE.md architecture section reflects two-call architecture, DefenseStore, arbiter, ESCALATE_REVIEW-only tier upgrades
  - References to # REVIEW-DEFENSE: inline comments removed from CLAUDE.md and SKILL.md files
  - Quick reference table updated
  OUT:
  - Creating new documentation files (only update existing per .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, future agents reading CLAUDE.md and the affected SKILL.md files have accurate awareness of the new review pipeline
  ← Satisfies: "Migration via best-effort file-path binding, fixture-based validation, and forward telemetry"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Follow .claude/docs/DOCUMENTATION-GUIDE.md for formatting, structure, and conventions

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
